programme_evidence: The congress programme page is a searchable listing by participant name, presentation title and Commission, where each session opens to its individual presentation titles and each title opens to its abstract.
method: 35th IGC, Dublin, 24-30 August 2024. THE WALL: the ENTIRE igc2024dublin.org domain returns a hard HTTP 403 (11,868-byte '403 - Forbidden' page, not a Cloudflare interstitial) to curl on every path tried - /, /programme/, /abstracts/, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and static /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf - with a desktop Chrome user-agent, Accept: application/pdf, Accept-Language, Referer and Sec-Fetch-* headers. The same URLs are served normally to WebFetch, which proves the site is live and the block is client-fingerprint based, i.e. exactly the case a real browser fixes. Wayback is unavailable: web.archive.org/cdx returns HTTP 503 'Internet Archive: Temporarily Offline', the same outage the pilot hit. igu-online.org carries no abstract figure and links only to the congress site and to igc2028melbourne.org. programme_evidence: The society runs a 'Program on the Web' (POTW) database addressed by convention id, with a summary view and a per-day event-detail view; it could not be opened without a browser.
method: The 52nd Annual Convention ran 21-25 May 2026 in San Francisco (intConvID=127). THE WALL, and it is a browser wall rather than a credential one: every /events/program-details/ URL returns a 6,646-byte 'POTW Loading' shell whose inline script sets a cookie named ScheduleHuman and redirects to potw-loading-2.aspx. Setting that cookie by hand in curl does NOT work - potw-loading-2.aspx is itself an ASP.NET WebForms page carrying an invisible Google reCAPTCHA v3 challenge (site key 6LcPIxcsAAAAAL6KOrt--8euqD0zd7LxAby565cJ, action 'program_directory', score threshold 0.5 in the ViewState) that must be scored before the programme is served. reCAPTCHA v3 is invisible and score-based, so unlike the All Academic v2 interstitial in the field notes this is NOT a human-only wall - an ordinary Playwright or Chrome session normally passes it. The society publishes no programme-book PDF: the media index paths that do work (abainternational.org/media/218315/ANN26_Opportunities.pdf, media.abainternational.org/events/2026/annual/registration/...) hold only the sponsorship prospectus and the registration form, and neither states a presentation count. One English web search was spent locating those files; nothing from any snippet is recorded.
rung5_targets: https://www.abainternational.org/events/program-details/summary.aspx?intConvID=127&a=r  - open in a real browser; it will bounce through potw-loading.aspx and potw-loading-2.aspx (reCAPTCHA v3, invisible) and then serve the Program on the Web summary for the 52nd Annual Convention.
